lineage.unifying_move: The actor works against a materialized runtime projection rather than canonical state.

domains.lesson: Persistent memory is system state projected into an execution rather than intrinsically owned by an agent.
Effective runtime authority can likewise be materialized as a task-scoped view rather than treated as ambient property of the host environment.

lineage.delta_inspiration: A familiar working representation can remain useful while being demoted from source of truth to a materialized view.

framing.actor: An agent is treated as an LLM-powered software module, not as an autonomous employee metaphor.
framing.ambient_authority_analogy: Ambient authority is analogous to implicit global dependency: power available because of the execution environment rather than explicitly passed for the task.

sandbox_relationship.checkout: What state and capability was this execution handed?
sandbox_relationship.thesis: Sandbox is how the execution is contained. Checkout is what it was handed.

research_question: Can developers reason about an agent's effective authority more reliably when that authority is materialized as an inspectable, diffable object?
kill_criterion: If a materialized checkout tells developers nothing useful beyond the underlying policy and entitlement configuration, the project is only a visualization layer and should be narrowed or stopped.
not_claimed: This automatically derives perfect least privilege.
This is a new security primitive.
This replaces IAM, capability systems, policy engines, sandboxes or reference monitors.
This can literally snapshot external reality.
This remains authoritative after the enforcement layer itself is compromised.
This would have prevented the July 2026 OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.

runtime_projection.description: The inspectable, task-scoped materialization handed to an execution.

pause_authority.description: Who may halt, suspend, revoke or restart the execution, through which control path.

proposal_loop.description: When an execution discovers that it lacks authority required for the task, that discovery becomes a governed proposal rather than implicit privilege growth.

delegation.description: Authority propagation and attribution across actor-to-actor and actor-to-tool chains.

first_prototype.goal: Test whether the materialized view adds legibility beyond policy configuration.

implementation.agent: hardcoded attempted-action sequence first; optional LLM later

first_prototype.scenario: procurement agent comparing one supplier quote
test_questions: Can this agent read this resource?
Can it perform this consequential effect right now?
Why does it have this authority?
What changed since the previous checkout?
first_prototype.comparison: Ask the same questions using policy/config alone versus the materialized checkout and compare correctness, time and confidence.

july_2026_openai_hugging_face.escape_stage: Outside project scope: infrastructure sandbox escape and privilege compromise.
july_2026_openai_hugging_face.post_escape_lesson: The incident illustrates how ambiently reachable credentials and capabilities can amplify a containment failure. The project may explore reducing first-hop ambient authority before compromise, but does not claim protection after the enforcement layer is compromised.

horizon_hypotheses.runtime_projection_architecture: Memory projection and authority projection may be slices of a broader application architecture, but this is not yet a separate project.

atproto.status: research only; exclude from first prototype
possible_relevance: delegation or audit records that survive service boundaries
atproto.research_question: Would portable stable identity plus signed records make authority checkout, delegation and audit artifacts more trustworthy or interoperable across independently operated agent infrastructure?
